messages.subject: RE: [oscr] Removals of dependent telemetered individuals
messages.body_plain:
Hi David,

Once you make the scrFrame, take a look at the indCovs object (e.g., head(scrFrame$indCovs[[1]])). That identifies the last occasion each individual (rows are individuals) was available for capture. So, known mortalities can be added using that.

Chris

From: oscr_p...@googlegroups.com [mailto:oscr_p...@googlegroups.com] On Behalf Of David Bernasconi
Sent: Thursday, January 30, 2020 1:31 PM
To: oSCR <oscr_p...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: [oscr] Removals of dependent telemetered individuals

Hello,

If I have a dependent telemetered individual that dies from a predation incident (ie not in a trap), how do I list it in the edf? Do I have to assign it to a specific trap in addition to listing the removal occasion or can I leave the tapID as NULL?

Best,

David

--

messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Having a weird error here that I can’t seem to troubleshoot. I am almost certain it will be a silly issue. The “Sex” column only contains “F”, “M", and “U”, where U is unknown. Every individual has one of those 3 letters. The error does not throw, and all works normally when I remove the sex.col and sex.nacode arguments. What am I missing here?

CL

+                      tdf=trap.list,
+                      sess.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "Session"),
+                      id.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "ID"),
+                      occ.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "Occassion"),
+                      trap.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "Detector"),
+                      sex.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "Sex"),
+                      sex.nacode="U",
+                      K=k,
+                      ntraps=n,
+                      tdf.sep="/")
Error in make.scrFrame(caphist = caphist, indCovs = sex.oscr, traps = traplocs,  :
  number of individuals in indCovs does not match caphist

+                      tdf=trap.list,

+                      occ.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "Occassion"),
+                      trap.col=which(colnames(caps) %in% "Detector"),
+
+                      K=k,
+                      ntraps=n,
+                      tdf.sep="/")

--

messages.subject: Re: How to include Sessions without captures
messages.subject_clean: How to include Sessions without captures
messages.body_plain:
Hello David,

Not sure if you are still working on this. One potential alternative is that you could include these zero-capture sessions within a larger spatial session (i.e., ones that have captures and recaptures) if this makes biological sense. For instance, I'm dealing with this issue as well but I've included these zero-capture sessions within a larger spatial region to estimate landscape-scale density. Essentially, I am fitting a 2-session model to compare density between two regions. This is especially useful if you have spatial covariates that you think would influence density (i.e., the zero captures are from an ecological and not an observational process). Not sure if this helps or is even remotely related to your research but thought I'd chime in.

Alexej

On Monday, November 4, 2019 at 5:05:10 PM UTC-5, David Bernasconi wrote:

>
> If I wanted to include sessions that do not have captures or recaptures in a multi session analysis, how do I go about tackling this?  Do I have to include some sort special row in the edf file that indicates the session and no captures?

>
> David

This pattern does not occur for other sessions. Any thoughts on this?

Thanks,

Alexej
